name: cli-tools
description: Turn shell commands into typed tools the model sees from the first turn

tools.title: Tools (JSON)
tools.description: JSON array of {name, description, argv: ["cmd", "{{param}}"], params: {param: {type, description, required?, enum?}}, timeoutMs?}. Empty or [] registers nothing.

maxOutputChars.title: Output cap (characters)
maxOutputChars.description: Stdout and stderr are each cut to this length before the model reads them.
